adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`, the referer is parsed via `URI(request.referer || '').host` and invalid URIs are handled by `rescue URI::InvalidURIError` (setting an error). The added controller spec only tests the `nil` referer case (`it "raises an error with no referer"`) and the success case where referer equals `embed_url` on the allowed host; it does not exercise (a) a foreign-host referer (the main negative path for `URI(...).host != SiteSetting.embeddable_host`) nor (b) a malformed referer that triggers the rescue branch. This is a concrete test coverage gap for newly introduced security-relevant logic (since the action sets `X-Frame-Options = ALLOWALL` only after passing these checks).
